$comment: 1. LOCALLY, per commit, by the husky commit-msg hook (fast feedback while you work).
2. IN CI, on the PR TITLE, by the `commit-scope-check` job in
squash-merges, the PR title IS the commit subject that lands on main — so
validating it closes the gap left when a web-UI commit or `git commit
The `allowedScopes` list doubles as the self-documenting registry of the
maintainer AREAS defined in GOVERNANCE.md. Adding a new area of the repo is a
one-line PR here (and a matching row in MAINTAINERS.md / CODEOWNERS). Scope is
OPTIONAL; a bare `feat: ...` is valid. A scope that is neither in `allowedScopes`
nor matched by `allowedScopePatterns` fails the check.
Sources of the model: CloudWeGo/eino .commit-rules.json + Conventional Commits 1.0.0.
